name: Booster T2 Edu
summary: A 1.4 m, 42 kg humanoid development platform with 31 joints; the Education version uses an ARM compute board and is sold with no hands, two grippers or two dexterous hands.

priceEur.note: Generation Robots "from" price for the T2 range (Edu E1 is the cheapest version); the page shows 27,060 EUR incl. 20 % French VAT and 22,500 EUR excl. VAT. Per-version prices appear only after choosing a version and could not be re-checked. Bipedal: Edu 30,821 EUR, Edu Gripper 41,531 EUR, Edu Dex Hand 47,481 EUR incl. 19 % VAT.

sellers.name: Generation Robots
sellers.note: "From" price for the T2 range (Edu E1, E2 gripper, E3-1 dexterous hand; Pro P1 to P3-3); delivery 4 to 6 weeks.

germany.statusNote: Orderable from Bipedal (Leverkusen, 30,821 EUR incl. VAT, about 4 weeks) and Generation Robots (from 22,500 EUR net, 4 to 6 weeks).

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: body without hands: 6 per leg, 7 per arm, 3 waist, 2 head

specs.label: Payload, both arms together
specs.conditions: maximum; maker notes it depends on configuration and arm posture

specs.label: Walking speed
specs.conditions: maker figure; Generation Robots lists up to 2 m/s

specs.label: Compute
specs.conditions: Education version; Generation Robots lists 350 TOPS

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Binocular head camera, binocular waist camera, microphone array and speaker; wrist cameras and LiDAR optional

notes: Base Edu E1 has no hands; grippers (E2) or dexterous hands (E3-1) are separate configurations at a higher price.
The 10 kg payload is for both arms together and depends on arm posture.
No rough-ground, stair or outdoor claims found for T2.

evidence.task: Sold as a development platform for embodied AI research and teaching
evidence.note: Booster calls T2 its flagship embodied development platform.
